title: Post-Incident Retrospective Action Items: Preventing Recurrence
workplace_track: ITIL Global Service Desk & Incident Escalation
description: Intermediate IT infrastructure and operations module analyzing post-incident retrospective action items: preventing recurrence.
learning_objectives: Master professional Past Unreal Scenarios (should have done) in enterprise IT infrastructure and cloud operations
Eliminate common Czech interference errors in post-incident retrospective action items: preventing recurrence
Demonstrate precision in Zero Trust architecture, ITIL incident management, and cyber governance

questions.prompt: All production cloud server access credentials _____ every ninety days under corporate security baseline standards.

explanations.correct: Passive construction with modal: 'must be rotated'.
explanations.wrong_A: 'must to be' is ungrammatical; modal 'must' takes bare infinitive.
explanations.wrong_C: 'must rotate' is active voice; credentials do not rotate themselves.
explanations.wrong_D: 'are must' is completely ungrammatical in English.

questions.cz_learning_point: Enterprise security policies strictly require passive voice with modals: 'must be rotated' (musí být obměňovány).
